Wood 2 League: Command 1 Corsair Ship with inertial physics and variable cargo mass. Collect floating treasure chests and deliver them to your Home Port!

 The Goal

Be the first pirate fleet to deliver 35 Gold to your Home Port, or have the most delivered Gold after 120 turns.

 Rules

The battle takes place in a 1600×900 sea sector with inertial kinematics, variable cargo mass, and rotational ocean currents:

  • Inertial Sailing (SAIL x y power): Applies thrust (0 ≤ power ≤ 100) toward (x, y). Heavier gold cargo increases ship mass and reduces acceleration:
    accel = power / (1.0 + 0.15 * gold)
  • Kinematics & Water Drag: Each turn, after thrust and currents are added to (vx, vy), the ship moves to (x + vx, y + vy), and water drag multiplies (vx, vy) by 0.78.
  • Plunder & Delivery: Passing within 85 units of a Treasure Chest loads its Gold aboard. Entering within 130 units of your Home Port delivers all carried Gold to your score!
Victory Conditions
  • You are the first to deliver at least 35 Gold to your Home Port (with a strictly higher score than your opponent), or you have delivered more Gold after 120 turns.
Defeat Conditions
  • You have delivered less Gold than your opponent at the end of the game.
  • Your program does not respond within the allotted time or outputs an unrecognized command.

 Game Input & Output

Initialization Input

Line 1: 3 space-separated integers width, height and leagueLevel, the width and height of the sea sector (1600×900) and the current league level (1, 2 or 3).

Line 2: 6 space-separated integers myPortX, myPortY, oppPortX, oppPortY, maelstromX and maelstromY, the coordinates of your Home Port, your opponent's Home Port, and the central Maelstrom.

Input for One Game Turn

Line 1: an integer shipCount, the total number of ships.

Next shipCount lines: 8 space-separated integers shipId, owner, x, y, vx, vy, gold and cooldown:

  • shipId: unique identifier of the ship.
  • owner: 0 if you own this ship (your ships are always listed first), 1 if owned by your opponent.
  • x, y: current coordinates of the ship.
  • vx, vy: current velocity components of the ship.
  • gold: amount of Gold currently carried aboard.
  • cooldown: turns remaining before cannons can fire again.

Next line: an integer chestCount, the number of active floating treasure chests.

Next chestCount lines: 4 space-separated integers chestId, cx, cy and chestGold, the unique identifier, coordinates, and Gold value of each chest.

Output for One Game Turn

One line per owned ship (in the exact order they appear in the input), containing one of the following commands:

  • SAIL x y power where x and y are integer target coordinates and power is an integer thrust from 0 to 100

You may optionally append MSG text at the end of a line. Example: SAIL 800 450 90

Constraints
width = 1600, height = 900
2 ≤ shipCount ≤ 4
0 ≤ chestCount ≤ 8
Response time for first turn ≤ 1000 ms
Response time for one turn ≤ 50 ms
Maximum number of turns: 120
